title: beccariella macrocarpa

The Australian plum has been traditionally used by indigenous Australians for its medicinal and culinary purposes. The bioactive constituents of Beccariella macrocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
